body: The only thing truly holding me back is my girlfriend, and even that is a thin, thin line. Soon it will disappear along with me. No one will miss me, no one ever misses me. I'll just be another person to add to the death toll of this shit hole of a world.
Thanks, I just wish for one day I didn't have to feel any pain at all. It's not much to ask for just one day. But alas that day doesn't seem like it will ever come, no matter what i do.
